# Triple Crown Group

> The AI hire small businesses have not made yet. We audit where time and money are
> going, build the automations and agents that fix it, and stay on to run them.

Triple Crown Group is a service area business founded by Noah Chaney, serving Greater
Cincinnati and Northern Kentucky and working remotely elsewhere. We work with owner run
businesses of roughly 5 to 80 people that are curious about AI, have not had time to get
fluent in it, and are not ready to hire someone full time to own it.

We are not affiliated with Triple Crown Consulting, a separate technology staffing firm.

- Contact: Noah Chaney, Founder
- Phone: (859) 414-4178
- Email: nchaney@triplecrown.group
- Service area: Cincinnati, Covington, Newport, Florence, Fort Mitchell, Erlanger,
  Crestview Hills, Blue Ash, Mason, West Chester, Liberty Township

## Who this is for

Businesses where a repetitive process directly drives revenue, where the owner is still
doing or overseeing that process, and where nobody's full time job is fixing it. The three
patterns we see most: speed to response, back office and paperwork, and customer
communication and follow up.

## How engagements work

- The Discovery Audit: two weeks, fixed price $1,500. We examine your busiest, most
  repetitive workflow and deliver a plain language report on where the time and money go.
  If we do not find at least one fix worth more than what you paid, the audit is free.
- Train and Build: we train your team on what the audit surfaced and build the specific
  automations and agents your business needs. Scope and cost custom to the findings.
- The Retainer: we act as your outsourced AI function, deploying agents, holding office
  hours, and troubleshooting. Scoped in hours per month. Pricing not published.

## Services

- AI audits to find where time and money are actually going
- Training your team on the AI tools that fit your business
- A tool audit of what you already pay for
- Custom AI agents built around your specific workflows
- Automations for lead response, quoting, scheduling, and follow up
- Back office and document automation
- Ongoing recommendations as your business and the tools change
